page_title: EIN 3-0 MON | Eintracht Frankfurt v B. Monchengladbach 14/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+3' The game is pretty dull as B. Monchengladbach are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
90+3' The possession of the ball – 44:56.
90+2' A corner kick by B. Monchengladbach is thwarted by the well prepared Kaua Santos (Eintracht Frankfurt).

90+2' Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
90+1' Eintracht Frankfurt failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Martin Petersen had an easy-decision to make.

89' What an opportunity! Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
87' The referee is firm and issues Love Arrhov (Eintracht Frankfurt) a deserved yellow card.
86' Hugo Bolin (B. Monchengladbach) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
86' Neat passing move from B. Monchengladbach in order to create new attacking opportunities.
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) was quite harsh and Martin Petersen didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from B. Monchengladbach comes to nothing.

83' Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the top right corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Kaua Santos.
79' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Haris Tabakovic as he is replaced by Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach).
79' Albert Riera decides to make a substitution. Hugo Larsson will be replaced by Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt).
79' Substitution. Ayoube Amaimouni makes his way off the pitch and Love Arrhov (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as his replacement.
78' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
77' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.

75' 3 - 0 Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) weaves his way past several defenders and finds himself in a one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy throws the keeper off balance and he simply puts the ball into the back of net.
75' The attendance is 59500.
73' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) brings an opponent down and Martin Petersen interrupts the game.
72' B. Monchengladbach are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
71' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is coming onto the pitch as Mario Gotze cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
68' The ball breaks to Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) after a scramble in the box, but his first-time effort is immediately blocked.
67' Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Moritz Nicolas is equal to it and makes an easy save.
65' Here is a change. Kevin Stoger is going off and Eugen Polanski gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Bolin (B. Monchengladbach).
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) coming on for Jens Castrop.
63' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) tackles a bit over-zealously and Martin Petersen blows for a foul.
61' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt).
60' Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
59' One of the players from Eintracht Frankfurt times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
57' B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Jean-Matteo Bahoya, but Moritz Nicolas displays great awareness to stop him.
54' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) has tested the patience of referee Martin Petersen and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
52' Great teamplay by Eintracht Frankfurt as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
50' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
49' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
49' The referee blows his whistle, B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.

48' Kaua Santos pulls off a fantastic save! Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.
46' Eugen Polanski has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Philipp Sander.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rasmus Kristensen trots off the pitch and is replaced by Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' The linesman signals a throw-in for Eintracht Frankfurt.
45+2' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) swings in a cross from the corner, but Kaua Santos reads it well and gathers the ball.
45+2' Eintracht Frankfurt are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

45' This would have been a magnificent goal from Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach), who collected the ball inside the box and prodded a first-time shot on goal that flew just narrowly wide of the right post.
44' Kaua Santos comes off his line to intercept the corner from Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).

42' What a great touch by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
41' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) has an effort from close range after latching on to a precise pass, but he can't beat one of the defenders who makes a good block.
40' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:1.
40' A clumsy foul by Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) and Martin Petersen blows his whistle.
38' B. Monchengladbach control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

34' 2 - 0 Stunning strike! Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to a precise through ball from Jean-Matteo Bahoya before unleashing an unstoppable shot inside the left post from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 2:0.
33' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner.
32' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to B. Monchengladbach.
30' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Martin Petersen signals.

30' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
29' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
24' 1 - 0 Goal! Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper inside the right post. 1:0.
23' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
22' A great run from Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post.
21' The injury to Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
19' Kota Takai (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the right side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper.
17' Albert Riera is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) suffers an injury and Mahmoud Dahoud comes on.
17' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but Kaua Santos comes off his line to gather the ball.
16' The B. Monchengladbach players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
14' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
13' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
12' Looks like Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
11' Flag up against Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
9' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) trips an opposition player and Martin Petersen signals a foul.
7' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
5' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
4' The B. Monchengladbach players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
2' B. Monchengladbach seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
2' The ball is behind the sideline. Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) takes a throw-in.
1' The first half has just begun.
